_comment: Template for /data/qqbot/surfcore/config.json. Change every CHANGE_ME. The bridge reads this ONCE at startup and has no fs.watch - always `sudo systemctl restart surfcore-bridge.service` after editing (docs/06-pitfalls.md P-11).

dsh._baseUrl_comment: MUST be a loopback address. The bridge only mints its dsh-auth cookie when isLoopbackBase() is true; a container service name here means every request gets 401 and the bridge stuck at 'DSH not ready'.

_consoleToken_comment: Empty = generated on every start into state/console-token. Console auth accepts ONLY ?token= or the X-Console-Token header; Authorization: Bearer gets 401.
_allow_comment: Anything not listed is dropped before it ever reaches the model. This is the #1 cause of 'the bot ignores me'.
_socialV2_comment: noActionLimit is the sneaky one: at the default 3, a few 'woke up but said nothing' rounds silently reset wakeConfig back to probability 0.05.
